title: ECG Mirage: Revealing and Mitigating the Underutilisation of ECGs in Vision-Language Models for Clinical Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.21755v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Emergency department (ED) decision-making relies on heterogeneous clinical information, including patient history, vital signs, laboratory results, and electrocardiograms (ECGs). Vision--language models (VLMs) can jointly process these modalities, but strong predictive performance does not necessarily imply meaningful use of the correct patient's ECG. We term this failure mode ECG Mirage: apparent multimodal capability without useful dependence on patient-specific ECG information. We distinguish two forms: ECG neglect, where ECGs provide little predictive benefit, and ECG confusion, where matched ECGs outperform no-image inputs but not mismatched ECGs. translated_title: ECG Mirage（心电图幻象）：揭示并缓解视觉-语言模型在临床预测中对心电图的利用不足
translated_abstract: 急诊科（ED）的临床决策依赖于异构的医疗信息，包括患者病史、生命体征、实验室检查结果以及心电图（ECG）。视觉-语言模型（VLM）能够联合处理这些模态，但强大的预测性能并不一定意味着模型有意义地使用了正确患者的心电图。我们将这种失败模式称为“ECG Mirage（心电图幻象）”：即表面上具备多模态能力，实际上却未有效依赖患者特定的心电图信息。我们区分了两种形式：一是“心电图忽视”，即心电图几乎不带来预测收益；二是“心电图混淆”，即匹配的心电图优于无图像输入，但并不优于不匹配的心电图。为评估这些行为，我们在保持临床文本和预测目标不变的情况下，比较了使用匹配心电图、结局不一致的不匹配心电图以及无图像输入三种情况下的预测结果。在MDS-ED数据集上对四个VLM的实验中，匹配的心电图在ICU入住等预测目标上均未带来一致的优势。
tldr: 该论文揭示了视觉-语言模型在临床预测中存在“心电图幻象”现象——模型表面上具备多模态能力却并未真正有效利用患者的心电图信息，并提出通过对比匹配、不匹配与无心电图输入的评估框架来区分“心电图忽视”与“心电图混淆”两种失败模式及相应的缓解方法。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the "ECG Mirage" phenomenon in vision-language models for clinical prediction—apparent multimodal capability without meaningful reliance on patient-specific ECGs—and introduces an evaluation framework comparing matched, mismatched, and no-ECG inputs to distinguish "ECG neglect" from "ECG confusion," along with mitigation strategies.
